title: TAROKE REMIXER
summary: The making of a generative poem becomes a visible, revisable encounter. Material, transformations, routes, and recurrence remain available for composition and testing.
responsibility: a compositional instrument can become an encounter of its own
meta_description: TAROKE REMIXER is a browser-native work by Mozare that makes the composition of generative literature visible, editable, testable, and exportable.
hero_lead: TAROKE REMIXER makes the construction of generative literature available as a work in its own right. Authored material and visible constraints remain near the lines they can produce.

views.title: Three views
views.intro: Three images hold distinct reading conditions without reducing the work to a single representative screen.
items: Banks and samples remain visible as authored material.
Forms and devices show how material may change.
Generated events return evidence to the composition.

context.title: The poem and the means of making it
paragraphs: The work continues the proposition made public by Taroko Gorge: a compact generator can be read, altered, and carried into another ground. TAROKE REMIXER expands that proposition into a compositional environment.

Material is named. Transformations are local. Line-making devices remain inspectable. Stanza and flow determine how the poem changes over time, and a completed project can leave the workbench as a standalone artifact.
